scope: Word-owned vocabulary and any eight Frayers in Biology30 A Pilot2/B/C/D and Biology20 A.

content.definitionPolicy: B/C/D and Biology20 A retain canonical word definitions. A preserves 28 primary entries and adds 113 separately authored related-word entries.
content.morphology: No unavailable-analysis placeholders remain. Contextual treatments distinguish compounds, grammatical forms, symbols, acronyms and personal names from morphemes. Existing A primary word-part layouts and cautions retained. Contextual analysis is not a claim of historical etymology.
content.review: Individual mechanisms, confusions and retrieval prompts were authored and inspected. C distinguishes chromosome copies from sets, linked from independent probabilities, template orientation and synthesis direction; D distinguishes counts, rates, denominators, assumptions, inference and ecological mechanisms. A separates sensory, neuronal and endocrine roles. Retrieval questions are learning supports, not observed student evidence.
content.sourcePolicy: Canonical teaching and vocabulary records supply biology content; the references are targeted cross-checks, not evidence that every word is a decomposable root. No generated origins.
content.boundary: Author review is not teacher acceptance or full curriculum certification. A's 28 exact original entries retain their original four-quadrant model comparisons after a complete attempt. No new full model is claimed for every added individual word. Broader category examples are not silently relabelled as word-specific examples. A collection copying includes word drafts and collected Frayers.

state.rule: Any eight words, four 240-character fields, initially empty, copy and explicit scoped removal. Existing category work keeps its original owner in legacy slots.
state.escapeBoundary: Pathological all-escape maximum states are rejected by the existing guard, not truncated.

release: Local candidates only; no deployment, ZIP, SCORM export, Studio activation or required-completion changes.
